From: Robert Joseph Evans <bobby@apache.org>
Date: Fri, 24 Aug 2012 14:16:41 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] HADOOP-8725. MR is broken when security is off (daryn via
 bobby)

git-svn-id: https://svn.apache.org/repos/asf/hadoop/common/trunk@1376929 13f79535-47bb-0310-9956-ffa450edef68

diff --git a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/security/UserGroupInformation.java b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/security/UserGroupInformation.java
index 967f0df89ff..0d3c4822892 100644
--- a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/security/UserGroupInformation.java
+++ b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/src/main/java/org/apache/hadoop/security/UserGroupInformation.java
@@ -642,7 +642,7 @@ static UserGroupInformation getLoginUser() throws IOException {
                                           AuthenticationMethod.SIMPLE);
         loginUser = new UserGroupInformation(login.getSubject());
         String fileLocation = System.getenv(HADOOP_TOKEN_FILE_LOCATION);
-        if (fileLocation != null && isSecurityEnabled()) {
+        if (fileLocation != null) {
           // load the token storage file and put all of the tokens into the
           // user.
           Credentials cred = Credentials.readTokenStorageFile(
--

diff --git a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt
index 7474fb87e4b..89a297ce485 100644
--- a/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt
+++ b/hadoop-common-project/hadoop-common/CHANGES.txt
@@ -975,6 +975,8 @@ Release 0.23.3 - UNRELEASED
     HADOOP-8709. globStatus changed behavior from 0.20/1.x (Jason Lowe via
     bobby)
 
+    HADOOP-8725. MR is broken when security is off (daryn via bobby)
+
 Release 0.23.2 - UNRELEASED 
 
   INCOMPATIBLE CHANGES

### Modifications in Each File

1. **UserGroupInformation.java**
   - The condition that checks if the `fileLocation` is not null has been modified. The original condition checked both if `fileLocation` is not null and if security is enabled (`isSecurityEnabled()`). The updated condition only checks if `fileLocation` is not null, removing the dependency on the security status.

2. **CHANGES.txt**
   - A new entry has been added to document the bug fix related to HADOOP-8725, which states that "MR is broken when security is off." This entry acknowledges the change made in the code and provides context for the modification.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `UserGroupInformation.java` directly addresses the bug described in HADOOP-8725 by allowing the system to load the token storage file regardless of whether security is enabled or not. This change is crucial for ensuring that the MapReduce (MR) functionality works correctly when security features are turned off. The entry in `CHANGES.txt` serves to inform users and developers about this fix, linking the code change to the specific issue it resolves.

  ```
  HADOOP-8725. MR is broken when security is off (daryn via bobby)
  ```
- This entry documents the issue that the patch addresses, providing clarity about the nature of the change in the context of release notes.

### Relationships:
The modification in `UserGroupInformation.java` directly addresses the bug outlined in `CHANGES.txt` regarding MapReduce failure when security features are disabled. The change ensures that the system can function properly by allowing access to the token storage file, thus resolving the issue logged in HADOOP-8725. The documentation in `CHANGES.txt` serves to inform users of the fix and its relation to the reported problem.
